high.title: Economists Adjust Inflation Forecasts for 8th Consecutive Week; See Focus Report for Monday (4th)
high.summary: Economists surveyed by the Central Bank have adjusted inflation projections for the eighth consecutive week, according to the Focus Bulletin released Monday morning. IPCA inflation expectations for 2026 increased from 4.86% to 4.89%, now outside the Central Bank's tolerance range for the inflation target. For 2027 and 2029, estimates remained at 4% and 3.50% respectively, while 2028 projections rose from 3.61% to 3.64%. Selic rate forecasts remained unchanged at 13% for this year and 11% for 2027, with 2028 staying at 10%. However, 2029 expectations increased from 9.75% to 10%. USD/BRL exchange rate projections point to R$5.25 by year-end, with forecasts for 2027-2029 at R$5.30, R$5.39, and R$5.40 respectively. This persistent upward revision of inflation expectations signals growing concern about price pressures and suggests the BCB may need to maintain higher rates for longer, supporting BRL in the near term but potentially pressuring growth-sensitive assets.

high.title: Market Awaits Itaú (ITUB4); Ibovespa in Dollar Terms Up More Than 1% Today (05)
high.summary: Brazilian markets are having an active day with Q1 2026 earnings season, with Itaú (ITUB4) results as the main highlight. The bank is expected to report weaker results pressured by seasonality, reduced credit activity, and the impact of early dividend payments that reduced available capital. Despite these headwinds, profit is expected between R$12-12.7 billion with annual growth and elevated ROE near 24%. The general assessment remains positive with the bank well-positioned to maintain high profitability and strong dividend distribution.
